Their world is closer than you think.
35213: Lesia, a teenager, is taken by a man to a villa where her fugitive father and his men are hiding. A war erupts, leading to death and a chase where father and daughter bond.
35725: Seven strangers wake up on the deserted streets of London with no knowledge of how they got there. Before long someone -or something - is picking them off, one by one....

37005: A hopelessly yearning hippie is left alone with a newborn baby when his just married parents go for a vacation, but wittily he finds a solution to get back his expatriate girlfriend, utilizing the baby who has no idea what is going on.

Mightiest thrill-shocked adventure spectacle of the super-sonic age !
Colonel Dutch Imil, CO 54th Fighter Group
38285: Madrid, 1965. When The Beatles arrive in the city, Diana goes to great lengths to meet them.

39053: Set in Sarajevo in May 2021, the city's famous Old Town tries to recover after a difficult pandemic year. When a visitor from Zagreb comes looking for the best kebabs in town, a harmless gesture causes the disintegration of the business and private lives of several people.
39309: A middle-aged gangster's lifetime of mistakes catch up with him as his personal and professional life is destroyed.
39565: When middle-aged Kata realises that her life will only be complete if she has a baby of her own, her longstanding-but-married boyfriend Joska refuses to comply. 39821: Thirty-five years in the life of Max, his best friend Sal and a woman they both adore, Lyla. Girl at the Birthday Party (as Tabyana Ford)

Not every child is a blessing.
40589: A rookie cop joins the crime branch of the Mumbai police department, and on his first assignment is faced with the dilemma of whether he should shoot a murder suspect who is attempting to escape or not.
40845: A poetic road trip through Pulitzer prize-winning CK Williams' life over the course of 40 years.
One man, one life. A thousand memories
41101: Famous auto racing champion Joe Greer returns to his hometown to compete in a local race, discovering that his younger brother has aspirations to become a racing champion.
Ablaze with excitement-heart pounding romance women never forget!
41613: After living a traumatic experience in Tokyo, Yukiko returns to Kyoto, where Hatsuko, her mother, runs a brothel, which upsets Yukiko very much.
41869: When Ricardo, a responsible father, decides to personally take his son to a camp in Asturias, other parents propose that he should also take care of their children. A hilarious adventure (as long as it doesn't happen to you)
42125: A school truant officer uncovers a young boy's attempt to fake his residential address and subsequently befriends the kid and his mother.
One day 11 year old Timmy decided his mother needed a playmate.
The Man Who Gives Emily the Test

They're worlds apart, but closer than anyone could believe.
42637: A single mother and her young daughter struggle to make ends meet until they inherit their family's farmhouse. When a business rival covets their water rights, the situation spirals out of control.
42893: A brash young American aristocrat attending Oxford University gets a chance to prove himself and win the heart of his antagonist's sister.
The roving romances of a two-fisted American!

43405: Uuno's father-in-law councillor Tuura moves to the country with his wife and daughter Elisabeth. Uuno joins them when it turns out Tuura's mansion is on the construction site of a new road. Tuura however is set on preventing this.
43917: France’s Bordeaux region has long commanded respect for its coveted wine, but shifts in the global marketplace mean that a new, voracious consumer base in China is buying up this finite product. 44173: This exhilarating rock 'n' roll road movie follows The Rolling Stones on their 2016 tour of Latin America, climaxing with their historic concert in Havana, Cuba.
44429: A young man is confronted with corrupt and vindictive colleagues at work and negligent officials at the hospital where his mother is dying. As he searches quixotically for a steadfast moral code by which to live, he suffers from the knowledge of human frailty and our darker inclinations to do harm.
44685: After an elaborate application process, Empress Elisabeth of Austria hires Countess Irma as her new lady-in-waiting and takes her to her summer residence on Corfu. As the two women become closer there, this soon leads to tensions back in Vienna.
44941: Inés works as a dubbing actress and sings in a choir in Buenos Aires. While on an idyllic trip she suffers a traumatic episode that she can’t recover from. 45197: Like the original film, the sequel is set in a near future where all drinking and drugs are banned except for on one glorious day known as The Binge. This year, that day happens to miraculously land on Christmas.
It's the most wonderful high of the year.
45453: Set four years after the first movie, Lin Xiao, Lily, Nan Xiang, and Ruby, confront opportunities and challenges as their school days come to an end.
45709: An impoverished employee tries to prevent his superiors and employers from marrying his sweetheart.
An impoverished employee tries to prevent his superiors and employers from marrying his sweetheart.
45965: Flora is a circus elephant who can no longer perform her tricks. The night before she's scheduled to be euthanized, the circus owner's 14-year old daughter, Dawn, sneaks Flora from the circus. How far would you go to save a friend?

Last mission to win this war.

46989: An average guy meets an actress who is more beautiful than he could ever imagine. But then a pesky girl materializes to make his life a living hell. His perfect girlfriend now thinks that he is involved with this Caprice.

Unfortunately, Captain Invincible is a drunk now...
What the world needs now is a shining hero!
47757: Jimmy Stevens, a senior VP at an international energy firm, blows the whistle on his company's deadly and corrupt practices in Latin America. Knowing he will be assassinated for his betrayal, he places an anonymous call securing the services of private detective Frank Turlotte to trail him from a distance.
48013: Do Not Resist is an exploration of the rapid militarization of the police in the United States. Opening on startling on-the-scene footage in Ferguson, Missouri, the film then broadens its scope to present scenes from across the country.
48269: In 1960, village inventor Chanan Singh tries to impress his in-laws by upgrading from his bicycle to a motorbike to win the affections of his wife Pakko, after a rival arrives with a new bike.
48525: Scott Barnes is an alcoholic turned social worker hellbent on saving a young boy named Tommy from self-destructing when he finds out he has begun selling crack in an organization called YIP, run by Carlos.
Never underestimate the power of a peaceful man.
48781: Reiji Kikukawa, who has a strong sense of justice, graduated from the police academy with the lowest score ever. In actuality, the firing is part of a carefully orchestrated plan to set him up as an undercover cop in the Yakuza.

Abandoned by their superiors, the two leading characters will lead an investigation on the drug that caused the politician's son to be out of his mind.

49805: Front of Aragon, 1937. Lluís, a young republican officer destined for a temporarily dormant position, meets an enigmatic widow of whom she falls in love, Carlana, who manages to fool him to falsify a Document that makes it the lady of the region. She's willing to do the impossible to make her daughter Linda thin so Linda will look like a little princess on the day she receives her first communion.

51341: One dark and stormy night, an escaped convict, an embezzler,  a runaway daughter, her intended and her father, and a gangster take refuge in a remote inn called "The Black Raven" after the nickname of a second gangster who owns it; and murder ensues.

And can Deepika escape Sukumar’s grip before everything collapses?
51853: A washed-up musician befriends a reclusive artist with an unusual name.
52109: When aspiring filmmaker David is mandated by a judge to attend a social program at the Jewish Community Center, he is sure of one thing: he doesn't belong there.
